description: Update a draft document revision body (Markdown) and/or summary. Published revisions cannot be edited — create a new draft revision first. Prefer rich-text drafts created via create-document-tool.

base_version.description: The lock_version returned when you last read this revision. A stale version is rejected; read and review the latest content before trying again.

body_markdown.description: Full Markdown body to store (replaces existing content). Required unless only updating summary.

revision_id.description: The ULID of the draft document revision to update.

summary.description: Optional short summary of this draft (max 255 characters). Pass empty string to clear.

name: update-document-revision-tool
title: Update Document Revision
